findings.claim: The shaper row no longer says the shaper writes the Log entry `(<date>, shaper)` that holds its design. Meanwhile the body says a `shaped: L<n>` mark points at that entry and holds only while the Log has exactly one such entry. After this change nothing tells the shaper to write the entry, so marks can point at a missing entry. The test assertion that guarded the duty was removed in the same commit (odd_role_skills_artifact_test.go), so the loss is not caught. This is a recall regression in the rules, and it is not part of the stated move of examples to references.

evidence: The diff removes the shaper's Log-entry writing duty from the Writes column and drops the matching test fragment.
The new body line still refers to 'its shaper Log entry' but does not instruct the shaper to create it.
I could not see the test file imports, so I did not assess whether `fmt` is imported in inception_chain_entry_test.go.
